title: File and surface declared gates via CLI and directives
description: WHY: a declared gate only prevents drift if the executor sees it at pickup. WHAT: (1) filing - extend the --required-gate parsing (apps/cli/src/commands.ts lines 10978-10989, currently kind or kind:scope) or add companion flags such as --gate-command and --gate-expect on work create and work edit, with usage documented in the command registry (apps/cli/src/command-registry.ts around line 1124); (2) surfacing - emit an advisory gap for every open declared gate on work show, work claim and agent start so the sprint 3 registry renders a blocking directive stating the exact command and expected observable at claim time (this depends on the sprint 3 inversion for the rendering path); (3) update the agent guide finish and evidence command hints (commands.ts lines 11114-11133) to echo the declared command when one exists instead of the generic pnpm test placeholder. Include the declared gate fields in WorkItemView requiredCloseoutGates output, which already passes gates through (packages/ui-model/src/work-view.ts line 134).
acceptanceCriteria: bwrk work create with a declared gate round-trips the fields into the record and work show --json

closedReason: Completed declared closeout gate filing and surfacing: CLI create/edit now accept declared commands and expected observables, work show/claim/agent start surface declared verification directives, and agent guide hints echo the active declared command.
